slides.text: you think peace is quiet, until you [[fall asleep]] while someone washes two plates in the kitchen.

caption:
the flat does not have to be empty for your head to settle down.
it just takes the right partner running the hot water down the hall.
send this to the person whose footsteps never make you sit up.
